headlines.headline: CLIPPERS, RAPTORS IN TRADE TALKS FOR KAWHI LEONARD
headlines.detail: The Los Angeles Clippers and Toronto Raptors have been in extended discussions over a deal for All-NBA forward Kawhi Leonard. DeMar DeRozan agreed to a one-year, $3.9 million deal with Denver, and Fred VanVleet opted into his $25 million option with Houston as he returns from a torn ACL.

headlines.headline: TEAMS FINALIZE 53-MAN ROSTERS AFTER WEEKEND CUTDOWN, 1,184 PLAYERS RELEASED
headlines.detail: All 32 teams trimmed to 53 by Sunday's deadline. The Titans cut QB Will Levis, leaving Cam Ward and Mitch Trubisky as Tennessee's only quarterbacks, while the defending champion Seahawks and Patriots — a Super Bowl rematch on Sept. 9 — both finalized rosters.

headlines.headline: WEEK 0 WRAPS WITH BELICHICK'S UNC UPSET OF TCU; MASSIVE WEEK 1 SLATE AHEAD
headlines.detail: Bill Belichick's North Carolina debut opened with a 15-10 win over TCU in Dublin, and No. 14 USC rolled past San Jose State. A 90-game Week 1 slate runs Sept. 3-7, headlined by Lane Kiffin's LSU debut vs. Clemson and No. 1 Ohio State (-50.5) hosting Ball State.

headlines.headline: KANSAS LANDS NO. 1 RECRUIT TYRAN STOKES AS 2026-27 PREVIEWS BEGIN
headlines.detail: Kansas secured a commitment from five-star forward Tyran Stokes, the No. 1 recruit in the 2026 class, as early Top 25 previews for 2026-27 begin to circulate and the NCAA tournament field expands from 68 to 76 teams.
